title: Chapter 1033
text:
"They want me to snatch that famous Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy for the dynasty?"

In a certain dynasty ally's stronghold in the Flickering World, Ravenlaude was surprised to receive the news from the dynasty's upper echelons.

As a member of the elderly heavenly group, Ravenlaude, who had the nickname 'Arcane Fox', had quite a bit of weight among the dynasty's Beyond Grade A allies. His position was even higher than Kohler and Beyoni, who were at the bottom of the food chain. Although he was not on good terms with Black Star, there was no conflict between the two of them.

Of course, Ravenlaude did not know that the Spacetime Amber that originally belonged to him had been taken away by Han Xiao. Otherwise, he would have probably joined the dynasty's anti- Black Star alliance that currently only had Heber as a member.

It was normal for the dynasty to ask him for help. What surprised Ravenlaude was the news of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy appearing. This was also the first time he had heard of this.

"Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy …" Ravenlaude's eyes sparkled.

To be honest, he was a little tempted.

This kind of Primal Esper Ability Entities on the Super High Risk Esper Ability List were extremely rare and could only be found by chance. If he could take it for himself, he would be able to cultivate a powerful assistant. Alternatively, he could use sealing magic to seal the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy on a special magic puppet and use its abilities to make it reach the standard of a Universal Treasure, turning it into a powerful magic tool.

However, this greed only existed in his mind for a few seconds before it was extinguished by Ravenlaude.

His organization was in the Constellation Corridor and was deeply influenced by the dynasty. There was no need to go against the dynasty's wishes for a Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

The dynasty told him this information to ask for his help. If he was tempted, he would be offending the dynasty, which was not worth it. There was no need for him to do this.

"However, a Universal Treasure …"

Ravenlaude was a little reluctant. It was not that he did not even have the magnanimity to let go of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, but ever since he saw Han Xiao's Spacetime Amber, his heart had always felt empty, as if he had missed out on something. He had formed an obsession with Universal Treasures.

This mentality was like a kid seeing other kids have good toys and could not help but want to get one too.

There was only one word to describe it — jealousy!

"Since the value of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy is comparable to a Universal Treasure, I can propose a condition to the dynasty."

Ravenlaude reported his request to the dynasty. If they wanted his help, the dynasty would have to take out a Universal Treasure from their treasury in exchange.

Not long after Ravenlaude made his request, the Empire's reply came. They agreed to Ravenlaude's request, but there were additional conditions.

If the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy appeared somewhere else, Ravenlaude would only receive some resources as a reward. Even if he did not contribute, he would at least be rewarded for his hard work.

If the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy appeared in the Emerald Star Cluster, as long as Ravenlaude snatched it back, he would be able to pick a Universal Treasure from the dynasty's inventory.

Along with the reply came a list of the Universal Treasures that the dynasty allowed Ravenlaude to exchange for. Most of them were combat equipment, and this was the list that he had taken out to exchange for the Evolution Cube with Han Xiao.

Ravenlaude browsed through it carefully and nodded in satisfaction.

Han Xiao did not care about these things, but Ravenlaude did … It could not be helped. As someone who had the Evolution Cube and the Spacetime Amber, Han Xiao did not care about normal Universal Treasures at all.

With the reward, Ravenlaude was finally motivated for this mission. He carefully looked through the list of competitors provided by the dynasty and smiled confidently.

How hard could it be to snatch something from a bunch of small fries?

…

Somewhere in the unexplored area of the Emerald Star Cluster, a fleet was moving through hyperdrive at high speed. There were no markings on the outer armor of the spaceship, so the origin of this fleet could not be determined.

Inside the main ship, a tall figure in a purple robe stood in front of the command platform. He had the aura of a big shot that kept people away as he stared at the star map silently. The red dot on the map also marked the coordinates where the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy would appear.

Beside him, a fish-like creature that was bound by magical ropes had a nervous look on its face. It said with a trembling voice, "That's right.

"Your Excellency Secret Master, I swear that this information is real. It's definitely EsGod's inheritance, not fake news that I made up!"

"That better be the case, or else you know the result."

A cold voice sounded. The purple figure turned around and glanced at him. His exposed skin was full of complicated and beautiful magic runes, flickering with fluorescent light. There was not a single piece of clean skin on his body. He was like a heavily addicted tattoo enthusiast.

Just like 'Beast Ancestor' Gorután, this person was also a protector of the Galactic Black Market. He was the famous' Secret Master 'in the Mage World. He had amazing knowledge in rune magic, alchemy, and mysticism. Especially mysticism. The reason he had such a nickname was that it was rumored that he had some kind of magic that could control 'luck' and was good at divination and prediction.

The tattoos on his body were all Taboo-level rune enchantments that could provide powerful enhancements to his main body. Secret Master's faction was characterized by extremely advanced rune magic technology, which was evident just by looking at his subordinates. Every one of them was wearing exquisite rune magic energy armor, and their exposed skin was also full of complex spell carvings.

Secret Master looked back at the star map, and there was a slight fluctuation in his cold eyes.

"Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy …"

Not long ago, he had suddenly divined that something big would happen in the Emerald Star Cluster that might be beneficial to him. Therefore, he had used the ability of the black market to investigate it. Under the effect of great luck, he had discovered a small organization that had snatched EsGod's inheritance back then. They happened to have the coordinates of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. After capturing and interrogating them, Secret Master had also become interested in the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

He was someone who did not mind using all kinds of external means to increase his strength. The enchantment runes all over his body were proof of this. At the same time, he also had a large number of high-quality magic tools in his hands. He had an obsessive-compulsive habit of collecting rare items. It was only natural that he would want to get his hands on something as rare as the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

Due to the distance, he had sent his officers to the other coordinates. However, he had personally gone to the Emerald Star Cluster, which had the highest possibility of being there.

"I wonder what kind of organization will come to snatch it …"

This question flashed through Secret Master's mind, but he soon forgot about it. He had great confidence in his organization.

No matter what organization came, he just had to beat them up. How many of them could beat a Beyond Grade A like him?

…

On the other side of the Emerald Star Cluster, in the stronghold of the Modo Civilization.

An elite team made up of Calamity Grade Supers gathered at a secret dock. The commander of the Modo Civilization's Expedition Fleet, Roddick, and Lagos stood at the front, inspecting this team.

"I'll leave the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy in your hands." Roddick nodded solemnly.

Some advanced civilizations also had some information about EsGod's legacy. Among them, the Modo Civilization was one of those who knew about the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy. There was no reason for the Modo Civilization to let go of such a good thing.

Other people were responsible for the other locations, but the coordinates of the Emerald Star Cluster were taken care of by the Expedition Fleet led by Roddick.

Ever since the Expedition Fleet was attacked by the 'mysterious organization', Roddick was pressured by the upper echelons and became much more vigilant. He was very careful when it came to mobilizing resources.

However, it was useless. The reinforcements from the Shattered Star Ring were often attacked by the 'unknown organization' on the way, which wasted a lot of time.

Luckily, after they came to the free competition zone, the Supercluster Civilization allies who were on the same side when it came to the Flickering World helped them a little, making the situation of the Modo Civilization's expedition fleet a little better. With a large number of bodyguards gathered, Roddick's fleet was no longer attacked in the Emerald Star Cluster.

Therefore, he freed himself and mobilized his elite troops, preparing to complete the mission given by the upper echelons and send people to capture the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy.

A Super Star Cluster Civilization had a vast territory and rich resources. They also had a lot of high-level combatants. Their Calamity Grade combatants numbered in the tens of thousands. It was not something a Star System Civilization with only ten to twenty Calamity Grade Supers could compare to.

The Modo Civilization placed a lot of importance on this expedition and had mobilized more than a hundred Calamity Grade combatants. This elite team that was sent to capture the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy included forty percent of the Calamity Grade officers of the Expedition Fleet, about forty to fifty of them. This was a powerful armed force that could completely dominate anyone below the Beyond Grade A level.

For this operation, the Modo Civilization did not inform the other Supercluster Civilization allies, planning to monopolize it … After all, there was only one Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, not enough to share.

Maybe other civilizations also knew this information, but the Modo Civilization obviously would not tell others voluntarily.

Watching the fleet enter stealth mode and set off quietly, Lagos came to Roddick and asked worriedly, "Isn't it too risky?

"Isn't it too risky to send so many people out? If anything happens, we'll lose a large number of elites. You have to know that every Calamity Grade is extremely difficult to nurture …"

"I told them to be careful. If there's a Beyond Grade A involved, they'll act cautiously. If there isn't, they can completely crush the other competing organizations," Roddick said with a deep voice.

"But if we send them out, our stronghold's defenses will be empty. Aren't you afraid that the Black … mysterious organization will attack us?" Lagos' eyes flickered.

"Humph, our Supercluster Alliance's strongholds help each other and even hired a few Beyond Grade As. These people are more reliable than Garoze. So what if Black Star is powerful? He won't dare touch us."

Roddick snorted. His tone was firm.

Now was not the time to rush. Back then, they were alone and helpless, so there was nothing they could do even if they were attacked. Now that their teammates had gathered, their defense line was impenetrable. If Black Star came to cause trouble, he would have to face the entire Supercluster Alliance. He did not think Black Star would dare do that.

…

At the same time, in the Star Pupil God Race's stronghold in the free competition zone …

After the Flickering World opened up, Sisko naturally would not let go of this opportunity. He also followed the Arcane Church to develop and built a stronghold in the free competition zone.

Because the three Universal Civilizations had a tacit understanding, Sisko was not targeted during this period. His days were quite comfortable. Seeing the exploration fleet's work getting better every day, he was very happy.

"Let's observe the situation first. If we can stabilize our territory in the Flickering World, we can move some of our people here and reproduce as a branch of our race."

At the top of the base, Sisko looked up at the sky and planned his relocation plan.

At this time, an officer hurriedly walked over.

"Leader, the base's radar has discovered two fleets approaching. They seem to be fighting. One of them only has three battleships left and can't hold on for much longer. According to their trajectory, the flames of war will spread to our stronghold very soon. What should we do?"

Sisko looked at the seven radar images and calmly ordered, "Chase them away. Don't let them fight near my territory."

After the order was passed down, the subordinate quickly followed it. However, after a while, this officer hurriedly ran over again.

"Leader, the enemy has been chased away, but the people we saved are unwilling to leave. There's a Calamity Grade Super among them. He thinks that you saved them and wants to lead his troops to join us."

"Seek refuge with me?" Psyker was slightly taken aback, his heart filled with mixed feelings.

He suddenly remembered that ever since he was targeted by Black Star, no one had come to join him for a long time. He had almost forgotten what a Beyond Grade A looked like.

This long-awaited feeling was really good …

"Invite him over. I want to see him." Sisko was gratified. His attitude became much friendlier, and he was prepared to personally summon him to show that he valued him.

After a while, this Calamity Grade Super was brought before Sisko. His injuries were not light. Clearly, he had gone through a fierce battle.

"Greetings, Your Excellency Star Pupil." This person had a face full of gratitude. Ignoring the pain in his body, he bowed respectfully. "You saved my life. I'm willing to join you and work for you."

"Hmm, it's nothing." Sisko looked calm on the surface, but he was actually very pleased. This person's respectful attitude made him feel like a Beyond Grade A again.

"To thank you for your kindness, I would like to give you a gift. This is a piece of precious information."

"What information?" Sisko was curious.

"Clues to the legendary Super High Risk Esper Ability, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy!"

Hearing this, Psyker paused, his seven eyes flashing with interest at the same time.

…

At the same time, in Black Star Palace …

"What, he invited me over, but he went out on his own?"

Ames narrowed her eyes. The temperature in the room seemed to have dropped by a hundred degrees. A powerful force field gushed out, rumbling and rolling. The floor and walls made of high-strength alloys around her trembled non-stop, making tearing sounds. Obvious distortions and cracks quickly appeared.

Aurora's legs turned to jelly. She lowered her head guiltily.

An angry teacher … is so scary.

Just from this powerful force field, she could feel Ames' anger.

She had happily accepted the invitation, came all the way here, only to find out that she had been stood up. Anyone would be angry …

No, this was not just as bad as standing her up. He was clearly not at home, but he had called her over. It was like a prank.

Even someone as carefree as Ames couldn't help but feel annoyed at being played around with.

Aurora swallowed and carefully said, "Teacher, why don't you stay here for a while? Uncle will definitely come back."

Ames glanced at her coldly and subconsciously retorted.

"Do you think I have a lot of free time?"

As soon as she said that, the two of them fell silent.

Aurora wanted to say something, but she stopped.

Don't you know if you're salty or not?

The two of them stared at each other, and the atmosphere gradually became awkward.

After staring at each other in silence for a while, Ames suddenly retracted her raging force field. Without changing her expression, she deliberately said in a nonchalant tone, "You can stay for a while.

I'm mainly here to find you. I don't care if Black Star is here or not. Seeing him annoys me. It's best that he's not here. "

Aurora: "…"

Under the influence of the first law of obedience, she felt like she believed her.
